dct_description_sm: Every year, since 1967, the Ministry of Natural Resources and Forests (MRNF) has been conducting an aerial survey and since 2024, with the acquisition of satellite imagery, the Ministry has detected some damage caused by the main insects and diseases that attack trees. This fact sheet focuses exclusively on data concerning damage caused by forest livery. The data is updated annually only in case damage is observed.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
